subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing (traffic replay)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-retail.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing (traffic replay)

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to lock the MAP milestone for load/performance testing so we can validate dedicated capacity sizing: 

Summary of ask:
- Goal: Replay production traffic for a 2-hour peak window to validate throughput and tail latency at peak QPS.
- Key success criteria: sustain peak QPS with <= 150ms p95 gen latency and no more than 1% error rate.

Proposed MAP milestone (draft):
- Milestone: Schedule & execute traffic replay load test
  - Target date: 2026-07-29
  - Responsible: Acme (traffic capture & replay script), Redwood (test harness, capacity provisioning, monitoring)
  - Dependencies: traffic sample, whitelisted IPs, temporary test API key, list of endpoints/paths, allowed test time windows
  - Deliverables: load test report (QPS, p50/p95/p99, error rates), dedicated capacity recommendation, follow-up plan if regressions found

Immediate asks from us to you (Alex / Priya):
1) Share a 10-15 minute representative traffic capture (anonymized) or a replay script by EOD 2026-07-16 (attachment option: traffic_sample_20260626.json).
2) Confirm which 2-hour window you prefer for replay (we suggested 10a-12p PT or 2p-4p PT).
3) Add the following IPs to your test allowlist for 2026-07-29: 35.204.12.45, 34.68.90.12 (we can provide a ticket if you prefer).

Notes on sizing: if your peak is in the ~8k-12k QPS range (as discussed), we recommend an initial dedicated pool equivalent to 8 x A100-ish workers with autoscale headroom. We'll confirm after the replay.

Attachments: acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), traffic_sample_20260626.json (example payload)

If the 29th works we'll book a 3-hour test window (1h prep + 2h replay) and loop in Vivek and Rishi on the test run.

Thanks

--
Marissa Cole

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-retail.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & dedicated capacity sizing (traffic replay)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Peak QPS: our telemetry shows a daily peak ~9,500 QPS and a short daily spike up to ~11,800 QPS for ~10 minutes.
- Preferred test window: Jul 29 (preferred) but we can also do Jul 22 if you need earlier. For Jul 29 we prefer 10:00-12:00 PT.
- We can provide an anonymized traffic capture but need guidance on fields to redact; we'll send the sample by EOD 2026-07-16.

On allowlist: we'll get the IPs to infra; do you need CIDRs or single IPs?

Also cc'ing Priya (product) to confirm the endpoints and any rate limiting rules to relax for the test.

On Jul 29, do you expect Redwood to provision a temporary dedicated pool or run the test on our existing staging nodes? We'd prefer Redwood to handle the dedicated capacity so we can avoid impacting other staging traffic.

Thanks
Alex

Marissa / Vivek,

Quick internal note from the infra sizing POV:
- If Alex confirms 11.8k short spike, we should size for sustained 10k QPS with ability to handle 12k+ short spikes.
- Recommended starting configuration: 8 x H100-class instances (or equivalent throughput) with continuous batching enabled + KV cache priming. This gives margin and lets us validate autoscale triggers.
- Test harness needs: replay script that preserves inter-arrival times, header preservation (auth replaced with test API key), and endpoint mapping file. The traffic_sample_20260626.json is a useful example but we'll need the full request template set.
- Monitoring: please confirm we can push Prometheus metrics to the shared test workspace and that Acme will share the baseline SLA dashboards post-test.

I'll pre-create the dedicated pool and a runbook once we have the script and chosen window. Vivek: please confirm resource slot and whether we need procurement approval for extra GPUs for the 29th.

-Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Alex / Priya,

Thanks — good to confirm. Per thread:
- Agreed test date: 2026-07-29, 10:00-13:00 PT (we'll keep a 1-hour prep buffer).
- Redwood will provision a temporary dedicated pool for the run and isolate it from your staging nodes. Vivek will follow up with exact instance types and a procurement note if needed.
- Action items:
  - Alex / Priya: share anonymized traffic replay script or sample by 2026-07-16 (Priya to confirm endpoints).
  - Acme infra: add Redwood test IPs (single IPs OK) to allowlist for 2026-07-29.
  - Rishi / Vivek: pre-create pool, test runbook, dashboards, and post-test report template.

I've attached the current MAP draft (acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a traffic example. I'll also create a shared Drive folder and a DocuSign placeholder (DOCUSIGN-67890) for any procurement approvals.

If anything changes, flag here — otherwise I'll mark the MAP milestone as scheduled and update HubSpot (DEAL-2026-1245).
